scope: Object names and the registered sensitivity or failure rule of each object (third column). The implemented primary values (second column) are read from the full configurations and from the observer, critic and sequence-model definitions in cross_morse/learning.py and cross_morse/core.py; the loss-clipping sensitivity grid is read from paper/registered_constants.json.

observer.rule: raw, EMA, global and conditioned filters; retain simplest calibrated

filters.rule: band deletion, scrambling and rank-only controls

clipping.rule: report clipped fractions and maximum unclipped harm
